13984-in-the-wrong-paradise-and-other-st.title: In The Wrong Paradise And Other Stories
13984-in-the-wrong-paradise-and-other-st.creator: Andrew Lang
13984-in-the-wrong-paradise-and-other-st.description: A book by Andrew Lang. The writer of these apologues hopes that the Rev. Gowles will not be regarded as his idea of a typical missionary. The countrymen of Codrington and Callaway, of Patteson and Livingstone, know better what missionaries may be, and often are. But the wrong sort as well as the right sort exists everywhere, and Mr. Gowles is not a very gross caricature of the ignorant teacher of heathendom.

41896-dave-fearless-and-the-cave-of-myst.title: _Adrift On The Pacific_
41896-dave-fearless-and-the-cave-of-myst.creator: Roy Rockwood
41896-dave-fearless-and-the-cave-of-myst.description: A book by Roy Rockwood. It was on the deck of the _Swallow_, moored in the harbor of a far-away Pacific Ocean tropical island, that Dave Fearless spoke. He had just rushed up from the cabin in a great state of excitement.

arxiv-2103-12438.title: Oriented pro- ℓ \ell groups with the Bogomolov-Positselski property
arxiv-2103-12438.creator: Claudio Quadrelli, Thomas S. Weigel
arxiv-2103-12438.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Claudio Quadrelli, Thomas S. Weigel. For a prime number ℓ \ell we say that an oriented pro- ℓ \ell group ( G , θ ) (G,\theta) has the Bogomolov-Positselski property if the kernel of the canonical projection on its maximal θ \theta -abelian quotient π G , θ ab : G → G ⁡ ( θ ) \pi^{\mathrm{ab}}_{G,\theta}\colon G\to G(\theta) is a free pro- ℓ \ell group contained in the Frattini subgroup of G G .

arxiv-2307-02882.title: Contrast Is All You Need
arxiv-2307-02882.creator: Burak Kilic, Floris Bex, Albert Gatt
arxiv-2307-02882.description: Abstract In this study, we analyze data-scarce classification scenarios, where available labeled legal data is small and imbalanced, potentially hurting the quality of the results. We focused on two finetuning objectives; SetFit (Sentence Transformer Finetuning), a contrastive learning setup, and a vanilla finetuning setup on a legal provision classification task.

arxiv-2405-20616.title: SCUBA-2 Ultra Deep Imaging EAO Survey (STUDIES). V. Confusion-limited Submillimeter Galaxy Number Counts at 450 µm \micron and Data Release for the COSMOS Field Facilities: JCMT (SCUBA-2) Astropy ( Astropy Collaboration et al. 2013 ; Astropy Collaboration et al. 2018 ; Astropy Collaboration et al. 2
arxiv-2405-20616.creator: Zhen-Kai Gao (高振凱), Chen-Fatt Lim (林征發), Wei-Hao Wang (王為豪), Chian-Chou Chen (陳建州), Ian Smail, Scott C. Chapman, Xian Zhong Zheng, Hyunjin Shim, Tadayuki Kodama, Yiping Ao, Siou-Yu Chang (張修瑜), David L. Clements, James S. Dunlop, Luis C. Ho, Yun-Hsin Hsu (徐允心), Chorng-Yuan Hwang, Ho Seong Hwang, M.
arxiv-2405-20616.description: Abstract We present confusion-limited SCUBA-2 450- µm \micron observations in the COSMOS-CANDELS region as part of the JCMT Large Program, SCUBA-2 Ultra Deep Imaging EAO Survey (STUDIES). Our maps at 450 and 850 µm \micron cover an area of 450 arcmin 2 . We achieved instrumental noise levels of σ 450 = \sigma_{\mathrm{450}}= 0.

arxiv-2503-08815.title: Cross-Examiner: Evaluating Consistency of Large Language Model-Generated Explanations
arxiv-2503-08815.creator: Danielle Villa, Maria Chang, Keerthiram Murugesan, Rosario Uceda-Sosa, Karthikeyan Natesan Ramamurthy
arxiv-2503-08815.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) are often asked to explain their outputs to enhance accuracy and transparency. However, evidence suggests that these explanations can misrepresent the models’ true reasoning processes. One effective way to identify inaccuracies or omissions in these explanations is through consistency checking, which typically involves asking follow-up questions.

arxiv-2506-14415.title: Hemisphere mass up to four-loops with generalised k t k_{t} algorithms
arxiv-2506-14415.creator: Kamel Khelifa-Kerfa, Mohamed Benghanem
arxiv-2506-14415.description: Abstract We compute the fixed‐order distribution of the non‐global hemisphere mass observable in e + ​ e − e^{+}e^{-} annihilation up to four loops for various sequential recombination jet algorithms. In particular, we focus on the k t k_{t} and Cambridge/Aachen algorithms.

arxiv-2507-19365.title: A Data-Driven Approach to Estimate LEO Orbit Capacity Models
arxiv-2507-19365.creator: Braden Stock, Maddox McCarthy, Simone Servadio
arxiv-2507-19365.description: Abstract Utilizing the Sparse Identification of Nonlinear Dynamics algorithm (SINDy) and Long Short-Term Memory Recurrent Neural Networks (LSTM), the population of resident space objects, divided into Active, Derelict, and Debris, in LEO can be accurately modeled to predict future satellite and debris propagation.

arxiv-2602-05771.title: Fit-Free Optical Determination of Electronic Thermalization Time in Nematic Iron-Based Superconductors
arxiv-2602-05771.creator: Alexander Bartenev, Roman Kolodka, Adrián Rúa-Meléndez, Jason Kawasaki, Chang-Beom Eom, Armando Rúa, Sergiy Lysenko
arxiv-2602-05771.description: Abstract We present a nematic response function model (NRFM) for fit-free direct extraction of the characteristic time of ultrafast electronic thermalization in iron-based superconductors, materials with electronic nematicity. By combining the NRFM for polarization-dependent pump–probe measurements of electronic nematic response with the two-temperature model (TTM) for sub-picosecond quasiparticle relaxation, we quantify the electronic thermalization timescales and their anisotropy.

pmc-10736677.creator: Angela Y M Leung, Terence Lau, Doris Y P Leung
pmc-10736677.description: ObjectiveThis study aims to assess the effect of the Blended Gaming COVID-19 Training System (BGCTS) on infection control practices, compliance rates and knowledge of standard precautions among all staff in residential care homes (RCHs). Design: A 2-arm single-blinded cluster randomized controlled trial. Setting: Thirty RCHs were recruited and randomized.

pmc-11493823.title: Physical, Psychosocial, and Practical Burden of Patients Receiving Care for Age-Related Macular Degeneration in Canada: A Mixed-Methods Qualitative Study
pmc-11493823.creator: Pradeepa Yoganathan, Bernard Hurley, Andrew Merkur, Chad Andrews, Jennifer A Pereira, Larissa S Moniz
pmc-11493823.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). PurposeAge-related macular degeneration (AMD) is a leading cause of irreversible vision loss. Documentation of the disease’s description and treatment experience of Canadian patients is limited but of interest given the aging population and resultant implications for healthcare systems.

pmc-11627501.title: Cross-species alignment along the chronological axis reveals evolutionary effect on structural development of the human brain
pmc-11627501.creator: Yue Li, Qinyao Sun, Shunli Zhu, Congying Chu, Jiaojian Wang, Ming Meng
pmc-11627501.description: Disentangling the evolution mysteries of the human brain has always been an imperative endeavor in neuroscience. Although many previous comparative studies revealed genetic, brain structural and connectivity distinctness between human and other nonhuman primates, the brain evolutional mechanism is still largely unclear.

pmc-11862654.title: Variations in self-regulation of behaviour among different groups of the Russian population during the second wave of the COVID-19 pandemic
pmc-11862654.creator: V. I. Rozhdestvenskiy, V. V. Titova, I. A. Gorkovaya, D. O. Ivanov, Y. S. Aleksandrovich
pmc-11862654.description: IntroductionDuring a pandemic, the population is required to adapt effectively to drastically altered environmental conditions to avoid the development of psychiatric disorders or other maladaptive responses. This adaptation is closely linked to an individual’s ability to regulate their behaviour effectively and to develop traits such as pliability and autonomy.
